$comment: Employee access list: a page of its own, linked from the zone form's notice (form.vars.accessListUrl) and opened in a new tab. It shows each of the signed-in user's areas (their rows in PS_Zone-Attestation-Assignments, matched on UserEmail) with the employees listed for that area in PS_Zone-Attestation-Access (AreaName must match the Assignments AreaName exactly; case and outer spaces don't matter). For information only: nothing is saved. Users need read on both lists. vars.formUrl is the zone form's page: the back link, and the link in the intro, return there (closing this tab when it was opened from the form). The French texts are drafts.

title.en: Employee access to your work zones
title.fr: Accès des employés à vos zones de travail

intro.en: This list is for your information only. There is no need to confirm this employee access list. Please confirm work zones using the [zone confirmation tool]({var:formUrl}).
intro.fr: Cette liste vous est fournie à titre d'information seulement. Vous n'avez pas à confirmer cette liste des accès des employés. Veuillez confirmer les zones de travail au moyen de l'[outil de confirmation des zones]({var:formUrl}).

message.en: There are no areas assigned to you. If you think that's wrong, contact your Physical Security team.
message.fr: Aucun emplacement ne vous est attribué. Si vous pensez qu'il s'agit d'une erreur, communiquez avec votre équipe de la sécurité physique.

subject.en: PS Work Zone access list: problem report
subject.fr: Liste des accès aux zones de travail : signalement d'un problème
